purpose: Teach: 目録/一挙/チェンジ/扶養/誘致/下部/所在地/本編

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の目録を作成されますね
lines.en: The police create a detailed inventory of the seized items.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation delivered with steady, respectful tone. Acknowledges competence without fawning. Even pacing, slight upnote at the end like noting a fact worth marking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者を一挙に検挙されますね
lines.en: And they bring in all the suspects at once.
lines.style: Continuing the thread conversationally. Warm acknowledgment of their coordinated effort. Slightly quicker pace than before, keeping the momentum of the list. Small weight on 「一挙に」—admiring the scale of it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査班の体制をチェンジされますね
lines.en: They even shift their investigation team's structure as needed.
lines.style: Steady, approving tone. Slight pause before the main clause, like he's thinking through the logistics. No performance—just genuine recognition of thoroughness. Even breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の扶養家族を支援されますね
lines.en: They support the victim's dependents while it's all happening.
lines.style: Quieter here—genuine warmth breaking through. Slower on this line, the care behind it audible. Slight softening at 「支援」. Not sentimental, just human.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯訓練の誘致活動もされますね
lines.en: They even conduct community outreach and crime prevention training.
lines.style: Tone shifts slightly upward—impressed by the breadth of it. Pace picks up again. Emphasis on 「も」—the *also* carrying weight. Like he's running through a mental checklist of their work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、組織の下部の声も拾われますね
lines.en: They listen to voices from the lower levels of the organization too.
lines.style: Thoughtful here. Slower pace. Recognition that this takes intention—not automatic. Warmth on 「声も」. Slight trailing thoughtfulness, like appreciating something overlooked.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の所在地を特定されますね
lines.en: They pinpoint where the suspects are located.
lines.style: Returning to the practical thread. Steady, efficient tone. Weight on the precision of 「特定」. Back to even pacing. Factual but warm—acknowledging skill without stating it directly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、報告書の本編も精査されますね
lines.en: They scrutinize every detail in the main body of their reports.
lines.style: Final observation. Slightly slower, more deliberate pace—the thoroughness earning a beat. Quiet conviction. No upnote this time; settling down into respect. The period feels earned.
